ThingDef.label: Mining Servitor Arm
ThingDef.description: A brutal but effective form of the mining drill, this replaces the entire arm with a drill, with small secondary mechadendrites to do any small fine work required.

ThingDef.label: Industrial Servitor Arm
ThingDef.description: A, by the Imperium's standard, midly more refined arm, with a built in fusion welder and more robust mechadendrites to do the important work of repiring damaged buildings and tanks while under enemy fire or other places too precarious for a humman to go.

ThingDef.label: Agricultural Servitor Arm
ThingDef.description: A servitor arm designed for agricultural work, with a built in seed planter and fertilizer spreader to make farming easier. the fingers are replaced with a many tiny mechasytches that greatly speed up gathering work, but destroy a small amount of the harvest.
